iti15:2.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaṃyojanampi samanupassāmi yenevaṃ saṃyojanena saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsaranti yathayidaṃ bhikkhave taṇhāsaṃyojanaṃ
iti15:2.2: taṇhāsaṃyojanena hi bhikkhave saṃyuttā sattā dīgharattaṃ sandhāvanti saṃsarantīti.
iti15:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
